_note: Edit 'seconds' to change a scene's length — scenes play back-to-back and the total is the sum (target 25 s). Scene 'id' picks the visual (rush | hourglass | order | delivery | endcard; older looks still available: hook | flow | burst | shine | brand). 'transitionOut' is the transition into the NEXT scene, centred on the cut (zoomFlash | foamWipe | blobSwipe | iris | bubblePop | none). 'headline'/'subline'/'line2' are the on-screen texts. 'vo' is the planned voice-over line (not rendered as audio in phase 1).
